firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently ate chicken goes last. The player to that person’s left goes first.
clarifications: The same first player begins the next day after each player has taken a turn.

sources.title: Flock Together Rulebook

internalEvidence: Sea Cow Games links this PDF from its How To Play page. PDF pages 9–10 were rendered and read; the rule assigns last place to the most recent chicken eater and the first turn to their left-hand neighbor, continuing clockwise each day.
